text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, why is there a manga here? Did 
someone leave it behind, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
! This ballet manga...! I've been wanting 
to read this for ages!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......There's still time until training 
starts, so...... Just a little bit, 
maybe......

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ehh!? Competing in an international 
ballet competition!? That's amazing...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Your nails are so worn down and 
chipped... Even so, you're still gonna 
practice, huh...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That was peak sports anime grit, 
'ssu...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...I gotta reread that scene again. Feels 
like it'll hit even harder than the first 
time..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation ended up getting completely 
absorbed in a ballet manga and completely 
forgot about her training.
